tools.name: get_shutdown_date
tools.description: Get the official deprecation/shutdown date, replacement and source for an AI model ID (e.g. gpt-4o-2024-08-06, claude-sonnet-4-5).

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: List AI model shutdowns in the next N days, soonest first.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search all tracked AI models (including retired) by name.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: All tracked models for one provider (openai, anthropic, google-gemini, google-vertex, azure-openai, aws-bedrock, mistral, cohere).

tools.name: get_changes_since
tools.description: List tracked AI model records whose status, deprecation/shutdown date, replacement or source changed since an ISO 8601 time. Poll this to stay current: on later calls pass the previous response's checked_at. History starts at tracking_since; an earlier since returns a warning (count 0 then does not

tools.name: subscribe_alerts
tools.description: Subscribe to deprecation/shutdown change alerts. Give a public https webhook URL (JSON POST on every change, checked daily) or an email (double opt-in newsletter + alerts). Optional providers filter. Returns an unsubscribe token for webhooks.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Stop webhook alerts using the token from subscribe_alerts. Email subscribers unsubscribe from the link in any email.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Per-provider coverage today: rows with a known shutdown date, rows where the vendor page gives no date, rows not verified today, and official pages that could not be read today. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_coverage · Private data: get_changes_since, subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe · Public sink: subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_coverage · Private data: get_changes_since, subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe · Public sink: subscribe_alerts, unsubscribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
